'''Guillaume Soucy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Quebec Provincial Championship]] on 29 April 2001 with Dark Cloud City, according to Maxim Briand's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2218">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-02-montreal-provincial-29-04-01d2218/ montreal-provincial-29-04-01], DeckTech (maxim "Burnt toast" briand, 2 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-02-montreal-provincial-29-04-01d2218/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
